learning_outcomes.text: Choose the right ChatGPT model, mode and interface features for a professional task
Construct prompts that produce consistent, reviewable professional output
Use ChatGPT with uploaded files and browsing while keeping outputs verifiable
Apply privacy, accuracy and review controls to AI-assisted work

integrative_case: A marketing manager must stand up a repeatable ChatGPT workflow for a 10-person team: pick the right model and mode for each task, set a project with shared instructions, protect confidential client data, and define a review step before anything AI-drafted is sent externally.
